lines.trans: Viktor, good evening. Where is Alisa?
And she and I decided to stay.
She will stay with me one more day.
You do not mind, Tanya?
Well, if she decided so herself.
Let us go, I will quickly say goodbye to her.
What for? I will pass on everything myself!
She is having fun there in the kitchen.
She asked me to say goodbye to you.
Wait, what happened to her?
Everything is fine, she is just playing.
And you still have not learned how to lie.
Tanya, wait, I will explain everything!

in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Напиши: трус не играет в хоккей.
examples.trans: Write: a coward doesn't play hockey.
The children are playing in the courtyard.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.
You do not mind, do you?

meanings.note: ничего не осталось = there's nothing left
condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence
goes right before the word it negates

meanings.en: to have fun, to amuse oneself

examples.trans: The children are having fun in the kitchen.

передать.gloss: to pass on, to hand over

meanings.en: to pass on, to hand over, to give

examples.trans: Please pass on my regards to your mum.
She will stay for one more day.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it
at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

попрощаться.gloss: to say goodbye, to bid farewell

examples.text: Я пришёл сюда навсегда попрощаться с тобой.
examples.trans: I came here to say goodbye to you forever.

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness
at the start of a sentence

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: as a conjunction: пока я сплю

побыть.gloss: to stay for a while, to be (briefly)

meanings.en: to be, to spend a little time
meanings.note: побыть одной / одному = to be alone for a while

examples.trans: Let's stay here a little longer.

meanings.note: у + genitive = from someone: у меня научился
the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
